activation_base_rule: exact current integration head containing every dependency APPROVED and integrated
activation_steps: Verify T12 APPROVED in dependency graph, registry and task gates.
Verify T12 ownership is closed out and interfaces reconciled.
Verify T12_CONSUMER_BINDING matches the current T12 downstream consumer contract.
Verify IMPLEMENTATION_BLUEPRINT and TEST_EVIDENCE_PLAN are present and consistent with FROZEN_SCOPE/PREBUILD_CONTRACT.
Verify current GAME_MASTER_POLICY required proof flags are exact.
Re-check the seven planned T13 paths against integration-only and active ownership.
Require repository-wide production governance/migration validation PASS on the exact T13 preparation candidate.
Through the integration owner, add @reservation:T13 with exactly the seven planned owned paths.
Claim T13 as ASSIGNED using claim_template on the exact post-reservation integration head.
Require the canonical task_graduation_gate T13 --target ASSIGNED to PASS on the exact post-claim integration head.
Create/rebase havenline/T13-challenge-director from exact post-assignment head.
Require the existing isolated candidate guard and BUILDING_ISOLATED graduation package to PASS before runtime/data expands.
claim_template: python3 tools/havenline/production/workstream.py claim T13 --owner challenge-director-builder --branch havenline/T13-challenge-director --base <EXACT_CURRENT_INTEGRATION_HEAD> --owned-alias @reservation:T13 --status ASSIGNED
